title: Senolytics dasatinib and quercetin in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis: results of a phase I, single-blind, single-center, randomized, placebo-controlled pilot trial on feasibility and tolerability
book_use: Chapter 12; Senescence for Sale; Checked 2026-09-02; Supports: 12 participants randomized to D+Q or placebo; all participants completed dosing and assessments; more non-serious adverse events in the D+Q arm; no serious adverse event attributed to treatment; Limits: Tiny pilot designed around feasibility and tolerability rather than efficacy. Investigators disclosed senolytic-related patent interests held by Mayo Clinic.
